Lina (partnerships): Quick sync — need to finalize QBR scorecard gating + cohort MDF pilot by EOD Friday. I put a draft sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ExampleLink — please don’t edit until we agree on pillars.
Marco (marketplace): I can export listing health and transaction signals. Will have CSV by Thu noon.
Ellen (finance): FYI finance prefers a pilot pool cap rather than per-partner uncapped MDF. Propose total pilot pool = $50k. Need partner legal names + tax IDs to set up tracking.
Sam (solutions): Recommend gating require 2 joint GTM assets and 1 enablement session completed. Also add SI onboarding checklist item for SOW readiness.
Priya (product): We can add a lightweight analytics hook so partners report two QBR metrics automatically (links to console/events). Need engineering ETA — likely 1 sprint.
Jared (partnerships-manager): Draft gating rubric below — please review: 
```
Gating rubric (weights):
- ARR influence: 30
- Marketplace listing + usage: 25
- Joint enablement completed: 20
- Co-marketing commitments: 15
- Technical readiness (SIs): 10
```
Marco (marketplace): Suggest swapping marketplace weight to 30 and ARR to 25 — marketplace traction will be the main signal for pilot success.
Ellen (finance): 50k pool works. Recommend per-partner max = 15k and milestone holdbacks (50% on deliverables). Finance will create MDF GL code and a simple claim template.
Ben (sales-ops): I can compile partner IDs, existing co-marketing commitments, and prior MDF history by Wed EOD. Will attach to the sheet.
Lina (partnerships): Action list summary: 1) Marco — export listing CSV (due Thu noon). 2) Ben — compile partner IDs + commitments (due Wed EOD). 3) Priya — confirm analytics hook ETA and contract points (due Fri EOD). 4) Ellen — provision GL code + claim template (due Thu EOD). 5) Sam — draft SI onboarding checklist & SOW template and drop into sheet (due Thu EOD). 6) Partnerships (Lina/Jared) — finalize pilot cohort & send invites (due Fri noon).
Sam (solutions): I'll add the SI checklist as a small table in the doc: discovery, SOW, dev handoff, enablement, success metric definition.
Lina (partnerships): If no objections I’ll lock the rubric Friday morning and send the QBR invite + agenda. Please flag any blocking constraints now. :thumbsup:
